lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Peppery lentil lunch bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette, peppers and cucumber
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil portion, then add the cucumber, lemon juice and parsley at the table. Put the courgette and peppers on the plate first, followed by the lentils and the fresh cucumber.
dishes.why: This is a warm, clearly named lunch with a loud vegetable and a fresh finish that reheats well at work.

dishes.name: Roxane's lemon lentil bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette, peppers and cucumber
dishes.method: Reheat Roxane's boxed lentils, then add the cucumber, lemon juice and parsley. Serve the vegetables first, then the lentils, followed by the cucumber.
dishes.why: This keeps the warm lentil plate simple while following the requested serving order.

dishes.name: Tomato chickpea supper
dishes.title: Chickpeas, aubergine, tomatoes and spinach
dishes.method: Reheat the chickpea stew until piping hot, then finish with the lemon juice and parsley. Put the aubergine and spinach on the plate first, followed by the chickpeas and tomatoes.
dishes.why: This is the comforting reheatable dinner; we traded extra variety for one practical 50-minute cooking session for everyone.

dishes.name: Roxane's aubergine chickpeas
dishes.title: Chickpeas, aubergine, tomatoes and spinach
dishes.method: Reheat Roxane's boxed chickpeas until piping hot, then add the lemon juice and parsley. Serve the aubergine and spinach first, then the chickpeas and tomatoes.
dishes.why: This gives Roxane the same warm, comforting supper with her specified serving order.

preparations.title: Courgette and pepper lentils
preparations.method: Rinse the lentils. Soften the onion and peppers in the oil for five minutes, add the courgettes and paprika, then stir in the tomatoes, lentils and water. Simmer covered for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender, then divide the ready stew into three named boxes.

preparations.title: Aubergine and spinach chickpeas
preparations.method: Soften the onion and aubergine in the oil for eight minutes. Add the cumin, tomatoes, chickpeas and water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Divide the ready stew into four named boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the lentils first: soften the onion and peppers, add the courgettes, tomatoes, lentils and water, and leave them simmering. While they simmer, chop the onion and aubergines for the chickpeas. Start the second pan when the lentils are nearly tender, wilt in its spinach at the end, then weigh the lentils into three lunch boxes and the chickpeas into four dinner boxes.
